_about: Every occurrence of a link pattern outside the builder must be listed here with its count and a reason. A new call site, or a removed one, changes the count and fails the guard (tests/url-builder/guard_test.py). Patterns: generateUrl( = a route path; showcase_url = the showcase's stored URL base; url.showcase = the template prefix of plugin links.

entries.reason: the builder: the path generator and the call inside url()
the builder: the stored base read by base()
the TABLES_DATA definition of the column
the ACP field mapping f2gpath (a form field name, not a link)
the JSON-sync exclusion list (per-showcase value, never in a file)
the asset base for the showcase's own assets (get_asset_url), not a link to a page; Batch 3 (D215) decides absolute asset URLs
